sources.title: SchedMD scontrol manual
sources.supports: Requeue0 disables requeue after node failure; job updates are available to an effective owner subject to site policy.

sources.title: SchedMD sbatch manual
sources.supports: The no-requeue option controls job restart policy; configured ForceRequeueOnFail can override it.
